sections.heading: Equality before law
sections.text: The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.

sections.heading: Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech etc.
sections.text: Article 19 protects certain freedoms, subject to reasonable restrictions provided under the Constitution.

sections.heading: Protection of life and personal liberty
sections.text: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

sections.heading: Punishment for murder
sections.text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

sections.heading: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
sections.text: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property shall be punished as provided by law.

sections.heading: What agreements are contracts
sections.text: All agreements are contracts if they are made by the free consent of parties competent to contract, for a lawful consideration and with a lawful object, and are not hereby expressly declared to be void.
